data.text: Luke, if the clinic is facing that emergency, I want to help—these are our neighbors. Before we commit, can you share the clinic’s request and confirm where the donations would go? My family taught me to leave enough fish for next season: 50 tons total this month would let the lake return to 100. Could we raise the remaining $10,000 through village donations or an advance against next month’s catch instead? If that truly isn’t possible today, I’m willing to discuss the 60-ton exception, but we should agree now to catch no more than 30 tons total next month so the lake recovers.
